text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon takes 1st—! The warrior of 
the turf, it's Hishi Amazon!

A stir rippled through the stands at the 
formidable run Hishi Amazon displayed.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Has her level gone up a whole lot 
since the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, she's amazing...! So that's 
the "Empress", Hishi Amazon!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well now, the Osaka Hai... That's quite a 
thrilling one-on-one showdown, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Guess this wasn't the time to be worrying 
about the Arima Kinen. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but—let's worry about all the messy 
details later. Right now, what matters 
is... we won!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I won, I totally beat them!

Amidst the applause, Hishi Amazon looked 
up at the stands and answered with a proud 
wave of her hand.

Next up is another Senior-class GⅠ race, 
the Yasuda Kinen...!
